text: Imagine you start dating a girl when you're 17 and just a few weeks later She moves in with you and you begin living together after a few years you decide to propose She says yes, but then tragedy strikes your future wife is diagnosed with cancer You're a professional Valorant player one of the most beloved in the entire world But you decide to walk away at the peak of your career to take care of your woman's health You start donating your own blood and other things because your genes are compatible You take care of every expense medical bills apartment rent household costs and pleasures for both you and your girlfriend You accompany her every step of the way chemotherapy treatments hospitalizations recovery You help your girlfriend build a professional career on streaming and video platform her audience grows exponentially in no time Meanwhile, you have to push your own channel to the background and in the end after doing all of this all this sacrifice She decides to leave you because she needs to discover herself. Some people might expect that in this video I'm going to condemn this woman and say something like this proves how bad women are they just use men and so on but no Not really I would even go as far as to say that just because 10th was there for his girlfriend Doesn't automatically mean she's obligated to stay with him forever. Now with that said what is the point of this video? The point is to remind guys that you need to take dating skills. Seriously. It is one of the most important areas of your life I think it was Warren Buffett who said that choosing a right spouse is the most important decision you will ever make and yet throughout Our lives in school university work We learn so many things that are not that important while learning about dating and relationships is often completely overlooked Look at what tense did from what we know he stood by his girlfriend later fiance when she was diagnosed with cancer He supported her made sacrifices helped her through treatment and was there every step of the way and to be fair That is what a good partner is supposed to do The question is was he doing all of that for the right person? What his choice of partner correct in the first place because when someone agrees to marry you and then leaves you after everything you did For her, especially after such a difficult period it raises questions about whether she was the right choice They started dating when he was very young around 17 and realistically at that age. Most guys don't have much experience with women That's why I often say to younger guys don't rush into serious relationships too early first get some experience go on dates parties social events Understand what you actually want Maybe after you've been with five to ten different women You will have a clear idea of your standards and what you are looking for because this is where many men fail You can be successful in your career Disciplined hard-working, but if you make the wrong choice in your partner It can affect your whole life and this is not just about tense Think about examples like Johnny Depp and Amber Heard Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie Kanye West and Kim Kardashian There are many cases where extremely successful men still ended up in very difficult relationships risking ruining their lives So the takeaway is simple. There is nothing wrong with being loyal supportive and making sacrifices for someone In fact, that's a great quality But it has to be for the right person and to choose the right person you need to have experience and understand how dating works
